in_sanskrit.name: किच्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: derived from the root 'kic', which means 'to strike, to pierce'. The suffix '-cha' is added to form the adjective meaning 'having the quality of striking or piercing'.

in_marathi.name: Kiccha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious or Defiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kiccha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kicchati' meaning 'to defy', 'to oppose'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with powerful and defiant characters. For instance, Kiccha from the Mahabharata is a fierce and unyielding warrior.

in_bengali.name: Kiccha
